def: Massah, a place in the Desert

occurrences.text: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the Lord, saying, Is the Lord among us, or not?
And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibroth–hattaavah, ye provoked the Lord to wrath.
And of Levi he said, Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah, and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;
